This mechanically produces impossible results: Sharpe of 21.9, 100% win rate, and zero max drawdown are not achievable by any real trading strategy, since they imply perfect foreknowledge of price direction. There is no out-of-sample validation reported despite an oos_data_file being referenced, and the perfect win rate confirms the backtest is simply measuring the leak rather than any genuine predictive signal. This strategy would collapse entirely if run live or on unseen data with proper causal signal construction.
